integrity: The packaged claim is supported by a self-contained all-prime proof and a separate exact cyclotomic enumeration. No independent mathematical validation or historical originality certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly three rows and three columns of Fourier tables on groups of order pq with distinct prime factors; it does not extend automatically to other orders or larger minors.
The finite checker exhausts (p,q)=(2,5),(3,5),(3,7) only; the all-prime statement relies on the supplied algebraic proof.
Earlier equivalent or stronger third-order classifications may exist outside the inspected published sources.
title: Complete third-order Fourier-minor rank incidence for distinct-prime cyclic products
